meta.title: Farhad Eyvazov — Full-Stack Software Engineer
meta.description: Full-stack software engineer building modern web applications with React, Java and Node.js.

hero.headline: I build modern web applications with <accent>React, Java and Node.js</accent>.
hero.subtext: I'm a full-stack developer who enjoys turning ideas into scalable, user-friendly web applications. I focus on clean code, modern technologies and creating real value.

about.heading: Who I Am
about.paragraph1: I'm a full-stack software engineer with a passion for building modern web applications. I enjoy solving complex problems, working with great teams, and continuously learning new technologies.
about.paragraph2: I have experience in both frontend and backend development, and I'm comfortable working with various databases, APIs and cloud tools.
about.imageAlt: Desk setup with a monitor showing code and a mug reading "Better Code Better Tomorrow"

responsibilities: Worked on developing backend applications using Java and the Spring ecosystem.
Built REST APIs and database-related features using Spring Boot, Hibernate, and Spring Data JPA.
Used Swagger to test APIs and Docker to run projects in containerized environments.
Built the company's e-commerce website from scratch, single-handedly.
Used React.js and Redux Toolkit on the frontend, and Node.js and Express.js on the backend.
Built a separate admin panel to manage products and site content.
Was part of the team building the Taskool.com LMS platform.
Worked on fetching data from the backend for various sections and displaying it in the UI.
Used the Agile approach and tracked tasks via Trello.
Mentored trainees in React and frontend development with a hands-on approach.
Provided technical support on React, JavaScript, component structure, and working with APIs.
